titleText: JTF News: CBC News, Deutsche Welle
mainText: South Korea reports 16 deaths during a heat wave, and President Lee Myung-suk urges action.

titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, BBC News
mainText: A volcano in Guatemala erupted, sending lava into the air.
More than 150 migrants were rescued after a boat caught fire in the Channel.
Ukraine drone strikes reported near Moscow resulting in five deaths, according to Russian statements.
A wildfire in the United States forced approximately 60,000 people to evacuate, with arson suspected as a potential cause.
